title: One Health core competencies and predicting factors for One Health workforce’s core competencies at the local level in Thailand: a case study in Nakhon Sawan province
core_idea: Examine and identify One Health core competencies and the factors that predict those competencies among local-level workforce to support multisectoral implementation.
tldr: This cross-sectional mixed-methods study in Nakhon Sawan province, Thailand, investigated One Health core competencies among 144 local workforce participants by collecting questionnaires and in-depth interviews and analyzing associated factors and predictors using descriptive statistics, chi-square, Pearson correlation, multiple regression, and content analysis.
